requirements:
This model describes a file system.
It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files. All file system elements have a name. Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements. Files have information about their extension and their size.

issues.message: The intermediate UML model does not correctly represent the relationship between File and FileSystemElement.
issues.evidence: Files have information about their extension and their size. Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements.
suggestions: Add an aggregation relationship from Folder to File in the intermediate UML model
